top_stories.title: 【リリース】claude-code v2.1.319: v2.1.319
top_stories.body:
## What's changed

- Changed auto mode with telemetry or feature flags off, including behind LLM gateways: calls the server can't check are asked about or denied, with no fallback to the built-in classifier; set `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=0` to keep using it (Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry are unchanged)
- Changed auto mode behind an LLM gateway: `CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_MODE_SERVER=1` turns on the server-side check even with `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_EXPERIMENTAL_BETAS` set; if managed settings set the latter, they must set the `1` too
- Added support for MCP tasks in the terminal: when an MCP server run

top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-python v2.6.0: v2.6.0
top_stories.body:
### Features

* **api:** add error code for ramp limit errors
* **api:** add error codes for External Key validation failures
* **api:** add support for signing organization members out everywhere


### Bug Fixes

* **bedrock,vertex:** raise error-code and status exception classes on platform clients
* **bedrock:** keep a custom http_client and aws_profile on copies made with copy and with_options


### Chores

* **client:** stop recording sampling parameters on OpenTelemetry spans
* **docs:** describe the type and message of API errors
* **internal:** define the status error mapping once on t

top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-python v2.5.0: v2.5.0
top_stories.body:
### Features

* **api:** add error details types and new error type values
* **api:** add ids filter to list workspaces
* **client:** add error classes for HTTP statuses and API error codes, and error_code, details and api_message on APIStatusError


### Bug Fixes

* **api:** capitalize CMEK in error details type names
* **api:** move some error details types to the resource they describe
* **bedrock:** raise a ValueError when model is "." or ".." instead of sending the request to a different path
* **bedrock:** raise a ValueError when model is empty instead of sending the request to `/model//

top_stories.body:
### Bug Fixes

top_stories.title: 【リリース】anthropic-sdk-typescript vertex-sdk-v1.1.2: vertex-sdk-v1.1.2
top_stories.body:
### Bug Fixes

* **vertex:** percent-encode the project ID, region and model in the request path, so a `/` in the model can't move the request outside `/publishers/anthropic/models/`, and throw an `AnthropicError` for an empty `model` or a project ID or region of `.` or `..`
